rule: Hypothesis, instrument bytes and evidence inputs are frozen BEFORE the instrument is executed. A success rule is never edited after results are seen; a failed rule stays failed in the result record. No bar, rubric, threshold, gate predicate or verdict contract is frozen or edited here.
claim_ceiling: Operational resume: orchestration diagnosis, deferred-gate completion, state claim-path repair and read-only ordered-work verification. No quality measurement, no bar movement, no serve or human-gate claim.
ordering: V1 hypothesis -> V1 freeze (pinned to final instrument bytes) -> instrument execution -> state update -> final-gates phase -> report -> commit
